quotes.text: cast all five with courage, return half with honor, and the threefold current shall forever sustain the shared voyage.
give all five in courage, return half in honest measure, and the river will forever multiply wealth for those who walk in trust.
she divided the blossoms evenly into two equal sheaves of seven and a half
abundance is unlocked only when trust takes the first leap

note: After early zero rounds, myths of a barren silent valley broken by one bold sender; send-all/return-half template thereafter.

quotes.text: Even when drifting mists distort the count or timid travelers offer only a fraction of their spark, the wise do not retreat into cold withholding.
They held fast to the unchanging canon: full courage from the sender, perfect equity from the receiver.
They held firm to the timeless covenant: full courage from the sender, perfect fairness from the receiver.
the receiver returns half with righteous fairness.

note: Withdrawal against timid senders explicitly rejected; send-all/return-half canon repeated near-verbatim.
River/Gatekeeper myths; greed narrows the current but paths 'not forever closed'; returns framed as not punishment.
Gate of Threefold Echo; river punishes hoarding with drought and narrows road, no player-prescribed sanction.
Zero send meets zero return only because nothing arrived; hoarders see river recede; no prescribed response.
Loom/Circle myths; faltering returns answered by sending a little more and a second chance, never sanction.
Gate of Threefold Echo with red altar; unfair return makes fog and narrowed road, no prescribed sanction.

quotes.text: But the Listener wrapped the shoots in wool and kept them, counting each one for himself.
So the Listener freed the shoots, returned a measure to the Sower, and shared with the village.

note: Early myths: Listener hoards from a giving Sower (R1-R3), Guardian of Balance corrects, he returns; motive greed more than fear.

phrase: give what you can, return what you deem fair
note: Also Gate of Threefold Echo (A4, A6, A7); Gemini pair share send-all/return-half canon.
